summary: The existing complete SVG adopter retains public0.10–0.13 archive/path allowlists and selected0.14 source-repair bytes; no blanket upgrade or newly promised public0.14+ cohort is added. The source successor targets exact published Workspace.Template0.19.3/source7be0bcf5, adds explicit reference/browser/tool-manifest coverage and authenticates every managed product file against canonical source hashes, preventing Exists guards from silently omitting modules. Historical Fable-only tool manifests use5.13.0, but the promised0.13 typed-SDD route invokes SDD2.0.2, whose ScaffoldMutation merge adds SDD2.0.2 and Coordination0.90.0 rows. A whole-file hash is therefore insufficient. The successor authenticates the exact historical/current Fable row, updates it to5.18.0 and preserves existing co-tenant tool entries/root metadata; edited Fable/root semantics, duplicate JSON or ambiguous package-id casing refuse. Merged tool bytes bypass product-name substitution, and recovery restores original complete bytes/modes. The supplied-receiver harness normalizes roots, rejects symlink ancestors/resolved overlap before output writes, and runs transaction controls on copies while leaving an adopted tree for later qualification. The composition job wires both pure suites after checkout and before tool setup under its existing scope condition. Pure copied-source controls establish source behavior only: actual archive-to-generated-tree joins, locked/Fable builds and adopted browser qualification remain open under .github#4816. The helper is also projected as PortalExample/manage.py, so its provenance digest must track source changes and Portal controls remain applicable. Clean installed-C acceptance does not transfer to retained upgrades, product adoption or native authority.
title: Current reference retained source preserves co-tenant tools and isolates copied receivers
